name: Yannick
title: Spar-master of the Row
examine: He walks the length of a mast three times before he touches it. Nobody has ever seen him hurry and nobody has ever seen one of his spars fail.
lines: A mast is one tree or it is firewood. There is no third thing.
I turned down a Crown order last spring. The grain ran off at the shoulder. He can wait for a better tree.
Saltmere buys my spars and puts eyes on the hull. I have never seen the sea.
